tokens.name: bg-canvas
tokens.usage: Page background (dark: neutral-950). Body, app-shell main area, top bar.

tokens.name: bg-surface
tokens.usage: Hover/active step for deep containers and clickable deep cards; draggable or selectable items (kanban cards, package cards); secondary-button hover. One step above deep.

tokens.name: bg-surface-raised
tokens.usage: Small floating UI that needs option-hover contrast: menus, popovers, tooltips, toasts, coach marks; selected segment/tab pills; draggable wishlist cards.

tokens.name: bg-surface-deep
tokens.usage: Default surface (system-wide). Sections, cards and read-only containers (.tpl-card, .vz-card, .vzpc, .vzcamp, .vzkb-col, .vzacc, form cards, empty states), side nav and the top header (.vzhdr), plus dialogs, drawers, sheets and the date picker (with --border-default + shadow to lift them). Clickable deep cards step up to --bg-surface on hover.

tokens.name: field-bg
tokens.usage: Input, select and textarea background (dark: neutral-950 so fields read as wells on deep surfaces). Applies to .vz-input, .vz-select and .vz-textarea by default.

tokens.name: bg-inset
tokens.usage: Wells and tracks: pill tab list, progress track, counts, neutral badge, empty-state icon disc.

tokens.name: bg-overlay
tokens.usage: Scrim behind dialogs, drawers and sheets (.vzdlg-backdrop).

tokens.name: text-primary
tokens.usage: Headings, values and body copy on bg-canvas, bg-surface and bg-surface-raised. Contrast — dark: bg-canvas 17.1:1, bg-surface 14.0:1, bg-surface-raised 9.5:1; light: bg-canvas 18.3:1, bg-surface 17.1:1, bg-surface-raised 18.3:1.

tokens.name: text-secondary
tokens.usage: Supporting copy, labels (.vz-label), table cells, inactive nav items. Contrast — dark: bg-canvas 11.0:1, bg-surface 9.0:1, bg-surface-raised 6.1:1; light: bg-canvas 6.6:1, bg-surface 6.1:1, bg-surface-raised 6.6:1.

tokens.name: text-tertiary
tokens.usage: Metadata, placeholders, helper text (.vz-help), table headers, icons in nav. Light: neutral-650 (5.3:1 on bg-canvas, 4.95:1 on bg-surface, 4.57:1 on bg-surface-deep and bg-inset; changed from neutral-600 in v2.1, which measured 3.7–4.35:1). Still lighter than text-secondary (neutral-700). Dark: neutral-400 (8.5:1 canvas, 6.9:1 surface, 4.7:1 raised).
